_comment: Lives of townsfolk (Expansion 6 C.4, docs/ADVENTURES.md §5.16, §8.10; game/story/lives.py). A life is npc.flags['life']: ties (kin are names first), a want, a fear, secrets, things of note, and the week's events. Words fill {their} {they} {They} {them} {are} {have} and a tie's name by its kind: {spouse} {son} {daughter} {child} {father} {mother} {parent} {brother} {sister} {sibling} {lover} {rival} {creditor} {patron} {enemy}; {town}. An entry's 'needs' is a tie kind (or 'kin', 'child', 'parent', 'sibling') the life must have.
